items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Well, I played with Gilbert. Me and a boy by the name of, uh... Alvin Clements.

ctx.x: He played beautiful breaks. You don't hear many trumpet players that play good, clean breaks anymore. Yeah.
Well, I played with Gilbert. Me and a boy by the name of, uh... Alvin Clements. He died. Alvin was a... Oh, he was a nice drummer. But he was a lazy drummer. But he could love some drums.
